id.help: Unique id; a map side names it in commander.

description.help: Text shown when the person picks a commander.

portrait.help: Art id of the portrait (not drawn yet).

passive.help: Skills always active for the side: plain ids or { skill, filter } entries.

meter.help: The power meter; it must fill by something.

perDamageDealt.help: Meter points per hit point of damage dealt.

perDamageTaken.help: Meter points per hit point of damage taken.

powers.help: Powers (at most 4): each needs modifiers or effects.

description.help: Text shown in the power menu.

cost.help: Meter points (at most the meter's max).

costGrowthPercent.help: Price rises by this % with each use.

modifiers.help: Skills active while the power lasts.

effects.help: Instant effects, each one of heal, damage, giveResource, refresh.
